related.title: 5G NR Polar：控制訊息與率匹配負載
related.titleEn: 5G NR Polar: control-message and rate-matching budgets
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 0.48828125 information/code bit 與 0.651041666667 information/code bit，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 0.48828125 information/code bit and 0.651041666667 information/code bit, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋0.375 input/code bit與0.75 input/code bit，建立polar_budget.csv、CRC掩碼測例、位置映射，並完成以下驗收：在教學輸入碼率<=0.5時僅128配置通過；不得由此宣稱任何實際PDCCH可靠度。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 0.375 input/code bit and 0.75 input/code bit; create polar_budget.csv, CRC-mask fixtures and position mapping; apply this acceptance decision: Only the128-bit case meets the teaching input-rate limit0.5; it establishes no real PDCCH reliability claim.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 有效碼率應用資訊位元除以實際傳送編碼位元；CRC、填充與率匹配需分別記帳，不能把所有校驗當有效資料。 展開基準式 1000/2048；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：分別列資訊碼率1000/E與含CRC比率1024/E；碼率增加並未增加原始1000 bit。 將兩條推導一起存入 ldpc_bit_ledger.csv、率匹配索引測例、資訊/CRC分欄。
從原理 Polar控制通道以有限訊息與校驗位元形成編碼負載；本課只查位元預算，不把碼率計算當Polar解碼器。 展開基準式 (32+16)/128；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：逐欄加總32+16=48，並查128/64傳送位置是否重複或漏填；另列有效訊息比率。 將兩條推導一起存入 polar_budget.csv、CRC掩碼測例、位置映射。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Effective code rate uses information bits divided by transmitted coded bits; CRC, filler and rate matching require separate accounting., expand baseline expression 1000/2048; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: List1000/E separately from CRC-inclusive1024/E; a higher rate does not create more than1000 information bits. Save both derivations with ldpc_bit_ledger.csv, rate-matching index fixtures and information/CRC columns.

Starting from Polar control-channel coding starts from message and check bits; this investigation audits bit budgets rather than implementing a Polar decoder., expand baseline expression (32+16)/128; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Check32+16=48 and inspect128/64 transmitted positions for duplicates or gaps; report message-only rate separately. Save both derivations with polar_budget.csv, CRC-mask fixtures and position mapping.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Wi-Fi 6 BSS Coloring：空間重用的干擾餘裕
related.titleEn: Wi-Fi6 BSS coloring: interference margin for spatial reuse
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 0.48828125 information/code bit 與 0.651041666667 information/code bit，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 0.48828125 information/code bit and 0.651041666667 information/code bit, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋30 dB與10 dB，建立bss_reuse.csv、線性功率表、顏色分類證據，並完成以下驗收：題設S/I至少20 dB時第二組不允許同時傳送；不能單用不同顏色作放行條件。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 30 dB and 10 dB; create bss_reuse.csv, linear-power table and BSS classification evidence; apply this acceptance decision: With a20 dB S/I target, reject concurrency in the second case; different colors alone are insufficient.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 有效碼率應用資訊位元除以實際傳送編碼位元；CRC、填充與率匹配需分別記帳，不能把所有校驗當有效資料。 展開基準式 1000/2048；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：分別列資訊碼率1000/E與含CRC比率1024/E；碼率增加並未增加原始1000 bit。 將兩條推導一起存入 ldpc_bit_ledger.csv、率匹配索引測例、資訊/CRC分欄。
從原理 BSS顏色識別不同基本服務集，不能消除物理干擾；重用決策仍要依接收訊號與干擾條件。 展開基準式 -50-(-80)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：在線性功率域計比值1000與10；若雜訊不可忽略，必須加總I+N後改算SINR。 將兩條推導一起存入 bss_reuse.csv、線性功率表、顏色分類證據。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Effective code rate uses information bits divided by transmitted coded bits; CRC, filler and rate matching require separate accounting., expand baseline expression 1000/2048; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: List1000/E separately from CRC-inclusive1024/E; a higher rate does not create more than1000 information bits. Save both derivations with ldpc_bit_ledger.csv, rate-matching index fixtures and information/CRC columns.

Starting from BSS color identifies different service sets but does not cancel interference; reuse still needs signal/interference evidence., expand baseline expression -50-(-80); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Verify linear ratios1000 and10; when noise matters, sumI+N before calculating SINR. Save both derivations with bss_reuse.csv, linear-power table and BSS classification evidence.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
